scope: Streaming paged checkpoints with pinned target generations, concurrent writes, and bounded output

runtime_configuration.route: storage-only PagedReadHandle snapshot and file-backed durable base pack; no service route activated
runtime_configuration.target: The writer pins a synced committed target; pack streaming accepts later commits, and publication merges only matching target images while retaining newer WAL locators.
runtime_configuration.pack_output: sorted exact page images streamed through a resumable fixed-depth descriptor cursor; each slice emits at most its configured page count; coalesced buffer is four pages (16 KiB), uncoalesced buffer is one page (4 KiB)
runtime_configuration.memory_reservation: CheckpointValidation progress reservation is 6 pages for coalesced output or 3 pages for uncoalesced output; page loader separately charges decoded pages
runtime_configuration.publication: Sync complete or incremental pack; validate it against the pinned target; merge into the latest root without overwriting later writes; sync a next WAL segment at the latest committed LSN; sync WAL directory; publish manifest pointer; then switch writer generation. Process-crash and actual pointer-write faults remain unverified.
runtime_configuration.checkpoint_worker: One active checkpoint job per PagedTransactionWriter; a job retains its output reservation and cursor between slices; overlapping jobs are rejected and job drop or publication releases the worker slot; fair cross-tenant scheduling is not implemented.
runtime_configuration.pointer_faults: Injectable boundaries exist before pointer temporary creation, after temporary-file sync, after atomic rename, and after directory sync; the exercised writer path fails after temporary-file sync.
runtime_configuration.pack_failure: Checkpoint jobs accept a storage fault injector; a page-write failure keeps the manifest selected and releases the single active worker lease when the failed job is dropped.
runtime_configuration.disk_accounting: Retained pack, WAL, source-catalog, and version-index node usage is keyed by tenant and canonical directories in the shared disk manager and survives source/index manager drop; reopen reconciles actual bytes without duplicate charges. Version-index node creation reserves before file creation and converts the reservation atomically to persistent usage; GC reconciles retained node bytes while serialized with node writes. Paged WAL appends reserve a checked maximum frame bound before writing and reconcile actual source-directory bytes afterward. Source-catalog, manifest-validation, and GC marker runs reserve 48 bytes per conservatively counted marker before directory creation. Active WAL remains charged to RetainedSource rather than a distinct persistent Wal category.
runtime_configuration.checkpoint_metrics: Global checkpoint metrics expose current and maximum WAL bytes above the configured threshold, accumulated closed time above threshold, current live duration and Unix start timestamp, queued/pending/cancelled checkpoint requests, and total/maximum request wait. Metrics are recorded in both the segmented PhysicalCoordinator and the legacy direct checkpoint path. These are aggregate observability counters; fair tenant scheduling and per-tenant debt attribution remain unimplemented.
